approval.mondayTask: SCR Monday desk (Monday 09:00, trawl + SMS, no confirm)
approval.rule: Every Monday at 9am UK this run fires on its own (same pattern as the New Order Agent). Trawl company OneDrive for info@southcoastrods.onmicrosoft.com via scripts/trawl-onedrive.ps1. Trawl media@southcoastrods.com for new catch reports and product shots (scripts/trawl-media-inbox.ps1). media@ is Google Workspace - open it with Gmail IMAP from MX, not Office 365 Graph. Never a sign-in prompt. Never reuse a catch that has already been posted. If there are no new reports, fill the week from existing OneDrive SCR/ST pictures plus any new media@ product shots. Do not name Graham or Stuart in a post unless it is a catch report. Then SMS both. They Accept or Reject each post on Preview. A follow-up text is sent only after every post has a decision, and only if something was rejected.
approval.smsTemplate: SCR desk - week of {weekStart}. {count} posts/stories. Preview: {previewUrl} Accept or Reject each post there. We only text again after every post is decided, and only if you asked for changes.

week.notes: Per-post review: 4 rejected and revised. Follow-up SMS after every post was decided.

variants.instagram:

ST-Ci is new for 2026.

posts.title: ST12 - the all-rounder
posts.body: ST12. 12ft 3.5lb. All-round, multi-range, bag work. Same special taper as the rest of the range - power when you lean on it, forgiveness when they are under the tip.

variants.facebook:
If you only want one length in the van, a lot of anglers pick the ST12.

12ft 3.5lb. All-round, multi-range, bag work. Same Special Taper as the ST13 - semi-fast, progressive, Japanese Toray carbon - without being the out-and-out casting tool.

ST10 for close work and boats. ST13 when you need to go long. ST12 for everything in between.

#southcoastrodsST12 #SCRrods #southcoastrods
